text: Although it was cold, we went to the beach. I like him, although he talks a lot. Although she studied, she failed the test.
I have already eaten. She already knows the answer. Is it ten o'clock already?
I got a message from Leo. What time do you get home? It's getting dark.
I'd rather stay home tonight. She'd rather not go. I'd rather walk than take the bus.

— Do you want to go out tonight?
— I'd rather stay home. I'm tired.
— Would you rather watch a movie or order pizza?
— I'd rather do both.
I used to play soccer every weekend. We didn't use to have a car. I'm used to the cold.
I should have studied more. You shouldn't have said that. We should have left earlier.

— I missed the bus again.
— You should have left earlier.
— I know. I should have set an alarm.
— Next time, you will.
I'm looking for my keys. She is looking for a new job. What are you looking for?
Don't give up. You're almost there. He gave up smoking last year. I give up! What's the answer?
I need to find out what time it starts. She found out that he was lying. Let me find out and I'll call you back.
I'm looking forward to the weekend. We look forward to seeing you. She is looking forward to her trip.
The hotel was nice. However, it was far from the center. I wanted to go; however, I had to work.
Actually, I'm from Colombia, not Mexico. I actually liked the movie. I'm currently studying English.
Even though he was tired, he kept working. I went to work even though I was sick. Even if it rains, we'll go.
Let's walk instead of taking the bus. I'll have water instead of soda. I didn't call her. I wrote to her instead.
I haven't seen that movie yet. Has she called yet? Not yet.
I still love pizza. Are you still working? He still doesn't know.
We have enough time. She isn't old enough to drive. Is it big enough?
I have lived here since 2020. I have lived here for five years. She has worked here since June.
I made breakfast for everyone. I did my homework after dinner. She made a mistake.
I can hear the neighbors. Please listen to me. I heard a noise outside.
She is a nice person. Many people speak English. Three people are waiting outside.
I was at home yesterday. They were very tired. Were you at the party?
How many people are coming? I don't have much time. There aren't many chairs.
She is an engineer. I need an umbrella. He goes to a university in Texas.
She said she was tired. She told me she was tired. Tell me the truth.
Can I borrow your charger? Could you lend me ten dollars? I lent her my book.
Please bring your passport tomorrow. I take my son to school every day. Can you bring me a glass of water?
The rain affected our plans. The medicine had a good effect. Stress can affect your sleep.
I have fewer problems now. Drink less coffee. There are fewer people today.
It's a beautiful day. The cat licked its paw. It's been a long week.
She is taller than me. Finish your homework, then you can play. If you're tired, then rest.
Their house is big. Put it over there. They're my friends.
Your phone is ringing. You're late. You're welcome.
I don't want to lose my job. This shirt is too loose. We lost the game.
He is a good player. He plays well. I'm not feeling well.
He runs like the wind. I work as a nurse. Do it as I showed you.
